caption:
You don't learn to swim on the shore. 🌊

Day 1, same lake. One jumps in. One reads about swimming. Day 30, he sinks. Day 30, book #4. A year later, one is across the lake. The other is on book #41.

Stop reading about it. Jump in.

Send this to someone still reading about it.

#juststart #perfectionism #discipline #selfimprovement #motivation
yt_title: You don't learn to swim on the shore 🌊
